final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AverageBytesPerMillisecond) AS OverallAverage FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.MediaTypeName, ma.AverageUnitPrice, ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond, ma.AverageBytesPerMillisecond / o.OverallAverage AS RelativeAverageBytesPerMillisecond FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.OverallAverage IS NOT NULL
